answer: Sybils must fund many identities, pay gas, and wait epochs to build plausible histories, while a single cedar-rooted reputation slot costs far less to verify. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and maintain a public work history, scored like growth on a trellis: only accounts with sustained, peer-verified output earn reputation weight. A detection plume flags clusters of new wallets sharing funding sources, slashing deposits and quarantining their votes until independent work proves them. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
